journal_citation.title: Structure and dynamics of the chromatin remodeler ALC1 bound to a PARylated nucleosome.

emdb_reference.details: The linked EMDB entry comes from a subset of the particles used for the present entry.

sample.name: ALC1/CHD1L bound to a PARylated nucleosome

complex_supramolecule.name: ALC1/CHD1L bound to a PARylated nucleosome
complex_supramolecule.details: The nucleosome was PARylated by PARP2 and HPF1 before addition of ALC1.

vitrification.details: 3 uL were applied on grid and immediately blotted for 2.5 s at blot force 0..

image_recording.details: Total dose was fractionated over 40 movie frames.

startup_model.insilico_model: Synthetic map at 30 A resolution generated from PDB entry 3LZ0 (free nucleosome) with the molmap command in ChimeraX.

final_reconstruction.details: cryoDRGN does not report any measure of resolution.

final_three_d_classification.details: Analysis of the heterogeneity in a set of 43698 particles with cryoDRGN.
